description: Phone Validation. Validate any phone number in E.164 format. Detects disposable and virtual numbers, identifies carrier and line type (mobile/fixed/VoIP), returns country and timezone, and computes a 0-100 risk score. Credit cost: 1 credit per call.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to keep in the response, with dot notation for nested fields (e.g. name,location.city). Does not change the credit cost.

query.description: The phone number to validate in E.164 format (must start with +, e.g. +33612345678).

name: intelligence_phone
title: Phone Validation
